text.title: Feeling thermometers in every state
text.subtitle: Share of adults who rate each above 50 on a feeling thermometer that runs from 0 to 100
text.note: Wave 39 from the survey team's final release of Nov. 6, 2026. Not for publication. Above 50 means 51 to 100: a rating of exactly 50, the scale's midpoint, is not counted. Every adult was shown each thermometer; those who skipped one (2.5% to 7.1% nationally, up to 17% in a state) are left out of its share.
